name: SEOryon
author: Seoryon

sections.description:
SEOryon is an AI SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) platform that researches, writes, and publishes articles built both to rank on Google (SEO) and to be cited in AI answers such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude (GEO). This plugin is the official connector that lets SEOryon publish those articles straight to your WordPress site, automatically or with a review step you control.

Every article SEOryon writes is grounded in real research before a word is written: the live search results, the real questions people ask, keyword demand and difficulty, competitor coverage and gaps, and your own brand voice, with contextual internal links to your existing posts. This plugin handles the connection so that finished, on-brand articles land in WordPress without you copying and pasting.

Learn more about the platform at https://seoryon.com.

What SEOryon does

  • Targets what you can actually win, not just high-volume keywords: it weighs real demand and difficulty against your site’s strength, so effort goes where it can move.
  • Writes complete, on-brand articles with genuine information gain, an answer-first structure, an FAQ built from the questions people really ask, contextual internal links, and an original hero image.
  • Fact-checks every claim and verifies every external link before publishing, and never invents facts about your business.
  • Runs a GEO / LLM audit that shows where you appear across AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude), then builds content designed to get you cited.
  • Analyzes competitors: who ranks for your topics, the gaps you can take, and how the top pages are built.
  • Surfaces relevant, high-authority backlink opportunities, never link schemes, PBNs, or spam.
  • Audits your site’s speed and technical health, in plain English, with the fixes that matter first.
  • Runs on your terms: semi-autopilot, where you approve every piece, or full autopilot, where it plans, writes, schedules, and publishes on the cadence you set.
  • Built on Google’s published guidance, with no keyword stuffing, no thin filler, and no risky tactics, so the growth lasts.

What this connector plugin does

This plugin does one job well: pairing your WordPress site with your SEOryon account, securely and revocably.

  • Generates a fresh, dedicated Application Password just for SEOryon, named so you can identify it under Users → Profile.
  • Sends home_url(), your username, and the new password to SEOryon’s secure pairing endpoint, gated by a single-use token that expires in 30 minutes.
  • Stores connection state locally so you can see and revoke the link at any time.
  • On Disconnect, revokes the Application Password it created (a local WordPress core call), so the credential SEOryon stored stops working immediately.

What this plugin does NOT do

  • It does not run any cron and doesn’t read or modify your posts. All publishing is initiated by SEOryon’s servers using the standard WordPress REST API.
  • It does not phone home for telemetry. The ONLY outbound request this plugin ever makes is the pairing POST, when you click Connect. Disconnect is local-only: it revokes the Application Password via WordPress core and clears local state, with no outbound call.

External services

This plugin is the official connector to SEOryon (https://seoryon.com, app at https://app.seoryon.com), a paid AI SEO content platform operated by Oryon Systems, a French company. The plugin is a pairing tool and is not functional without a SEOryon account.

It transmits the following to https://app.seoryon.com exactly once, when you click Connect:

  • The site URL (home_url()).
  • Your WordPress username.
  • A newly-generated Application Password (created by WordPress core for this purpose; the plugin never stores it locally).
  • The pairing token you pasted.

SEOryon stores the credential encrypted at rest and uses it solely to publish and update articles on your site via the standard WordPress REST API. No other data is collected or transmitted by this plugin.

  • Terms of Service: https://app.seoryon.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://app.seoryon.com/privacy

Disconnect at any time from Settings → SEOryon (this revokes the Application Password), or revoke it yourself from Users → Profile → Application Passwords. Either action immediately stops publishing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the oryon-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → SEOryon.
  4. In SEOryon, open Settings → Integrations → WordPress and click Connect via plugin to mint a token.
  5. Paste the token into the plugin and click Connect.
sections.faq:
What is SEOryon?

SEOryon is an AI platform for SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). It researches keywords, reads the live search results, writes complete on-brand articles, and publishes them to your site, built both to rank on Google and to be cited in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude). This plugin is the WordPress connector for it. Sign up at https://seoryon.com.

Can I use this plugin without a SEOryon account?

No. The plugin is a pairing tool. SEOryon is what writes and schedules the content. Create an account at https://seoryon.com.

How do I revoke access?

Either Disconnect from Settings → SEOryon (which revokes the Application Password the plugin created), or delete the “SEOryon” entry from Users → Profile → Application Passwords. Both immediately invalidate the credential SEOryon stored.

What happens if I delete the plugin without disconnecting?

The pairing credential stays valid: it is an Application Password stored by WordPress core, not by the plugin. SEOryon can still publish until you revoke it. Disconnect from Settings → SEOryon before deleting the plugin, or remove the “SEOryon” entry from Users → Profile → Application Passwords at any time, even after the plugin is gone.

Why does the plugin need Application Passwords enabled?

SEOryon publishes via the standard WordPress REST API, which requires authentication. Application Passwords are the WordPress-recommended way to grant scoped, revocable access without sharing your real password.

Does the plugin work with WordPress older than 5.6?

No. Application Passwords were added in WordPress 5.6. Please upgrade.
